job.title: Senior Product Designer, Payments
job.description: Contoso Ledger builds invoicing and payment tools for small businesses. We're hiring a Senior Product Designer to own the invoice payment experience end to end. You will run user research and usability testing, prototype in Figma and in code, and work closely with product managers and engineers. You'll extend our design system and make sure every flow meets WCAG accessibility standards. Requirements: 5+ years of product design experience, a portfolio showing complex workflows, experience with payments or fintech, strong interaction design and information architecture skills, and comfort presenting to stakeholders. Nice to have: experience designing AI features with human review, dashboards and analytics, and A/B testing.

gaps: No A/B testing experience on the resume
fit_summary: Seven years on payment and scheduling flows, including an invoice redesign tested with users. The main risk is no A/B testing.
